blush-cardstock.$description: Blush Cardstock — Page background, nav surface, dominant canvas — the warm paper everything sits on

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, section headings, hairline borders, icon strokes

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surface, dark-section text, button labels on chromatic fills

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Alternate card surface when a quieter neutral block is needed

steel-gray.$description: Steel Gray — Muted input borders, secondary helper strokes

festival-violet.$description: Festival Violet — Full-bleed section bands, secondary filled CTA, footer background — heavy, immersive, sets the serious stage

spotlight-magenta.$description: Spotlight Magenta — Primary filled CTA (DONATE), pull-quote text, heading borders, interactive emphasis — the loudest ink, reserved for moments that demand attention

curtain-orange.$description: Curtain Orange — Pull-quote attribution, decorative heading borders — the warm third color that gives the palette a poster-like three-ink depth

walsheim.$description: Single-family type system used for everything from nav to display; the broad weight range (400–900) carries the entire tonal system so color never has to shout alone
